book.name: Hebrew
book.title: De Letta Ta De Hebrew Dem

content: Cause ob dat, we mus pay mind mo den eba ta wa we beena yeh bout God Son, so dat we ain gwine waak way fom de right road.
Cause we know fa true dat we kin trus de wod wa de angel dem bring we. Ebrybody wa ain done wa dat wod tell um fa do, ebrybody wa ain folla um, God punish um. E mek um suffa jes like dey oughta.

So den, fa sho, we gwine git punish jes like God punish oda people, ef we ain pay no mind ta dis great sabation dat de Lawd Jedus fus tell bout. Den, dem people wa been yeh de Lawd, dey proob ta we dat dat way true fa sho.
Same time, God too proob dat de way e wahn fa sabe people, e true, by dem sign an wonda wa e done. E do all kind ob miracle. E hab people git wa de Holy Sperit gim. E gim jes like e wahn.
Jedus Show People de Way wa Gwine Sabe Um
God ain pick no angel fa hab chaage oba de wol fa come, wa we da taak bout.
Bot dey write someweh dey een God Book say,

content.text: dat mek ya consaan bout um?
Wa mek we wa jes people, matta sommuch ta ya
dat ya tek cyah ob we?
Ya mek man jes a leetle mo lowa down den de angel dem.
An ya gim powa an hona fa true.
Ya gim chaage oba all ting.”

content: Now den, wen dey write een God Book say, “God mek man fa hab chaage oba all ting,” dat mean fa say, God ain lef nottin dat man ain oughta hab chaage oba. Bot we ain see man hab chaage oba all ting fa now.

Bot we see Jedus. Fa a leetle wile God mek Jedus a leetle mo lowa den de angel dem, so dat cause ob God mussy pon we, Jedus suffa an dead fa sake ob all people. An cause Jedus suffa an dead, God gim powa an hona.

God mek all ting an da keep all ting like dey oughta be, so e right dat God mek Jedus all God plan fa um fa be, shru e suffrin, so dat a heapa people gwine be God chullun an hab dey paat een e glory. Jedus de one wa gone head ob dem people dey fa bring um sabation.
Cause de one wa da mek people holy, an dem people wa e da mek holy, dey all got de same fada. So den Jedus heppy fa call um e bredren.

content.text: “God, A gwine tell all me bredren bout ya.
Wen ya people geda fa woshup ya,

content: An e say too, “A gwine pit me trus een God.” An gin e say, “A dey yah wid all de chullun wa God gii me.”
Dem chullun yah, dey flesh an blood fa sho. So den, Jedus too come eenta de wol as flesh an blood, so dat by de det wa e dead, e able fa stroy de Debil, wa got powa fa mek people dead.
Dat how Jedus set free all dem people wa been jes like slabe onda de Debil all de time dey lib, cause dey been scaid fa dead.
Fa sho, Jedus ain come fa hep de angel dem. E come fa hep Abraham chullun chullun.

So den, dey ain been no oda way bot dat Jedus mus come fa be jes like e bredren een ebry way. E done dat so dat e able fa be de head man ob de priest dem, full op wid mussy, an da wok fa God wid all e haat, so dat e kin tek way de people sin an God kin fagib um.
Now, cause Jedus done been tempt an e suffa, fa true dat mek Jedus able fa hep we wen we git tempt.
